Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BHAVINI REF: 10005421 Please see the below mentioned points: Scope of Work: S NO. DESCRIPTION QTY UNIT 1 Supply, safe delivery and warranty of Employee identity card design s 1.00 Nos. oftware With single user perpetual license as per the specifications in annexure. Note: 1. Total Contract period is 30 Days. 2. Test Certificate should be provided. 3. Warranty should be provided for minimum 1 year from the date of final accept ance. 4. Prior experience is required. Necessary document should be uploaded along wi

th bid for evaluation. Else offer will not be considered for evaluation. 5. Since the scope of work involves installation & on-site training, the below menti oned 2 policies to be submitted before execution of the work with prior intimation. (i) Workmen compensation insurance policy. (ii) Public Liability with 3rd party insurance policy. 6. All other terms and conditions are applicable as per GeM GTC and ATC. 7. If offer uploaded from same IP address their offer will not be considered for furt her evaluation. 8. A Liquidated Damage Charges is applicable as per GeM terms and conditions. 9. Special Note: Bidders are requested strictly to submit all the required documents as spelt out in the ATC of the bid. In case a bidder fails to submit the required documents, th eir offer will not be considered for further evaluation. 10. Refer the below technical specification. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION 1. ID Card Design 1. User-friendly environment for designing personnel identity cards as per the organization's standard. 2. Design tools shall include Line, Rectangle and Ellipse shapes. 3. Dynamic fields shall support Text, Linear Barcode/QR Code, Image and Date/Time. 4. Design shall support the configured printable and non-printable fields a nd card layout. 2. Printing 1. Printing of selected card-holder details in the designed format, either as a single card or a batch of cards. 2. Print orientation, card size, printable/non-printable fields, magnetic-stri pe encoding and smart-card encoding shall be derived from the design tem plate and applied during printing. 3. Auto Print shall support background printing and integration with third-p arty applications. 4. Batch Print shall support one or more cards in a single operation and val idate the printed status of records. 5. Dual-side printing shall be supported. 3. Data / Database Management 1. Data module shall support linking to MS Excel, MS Access, MS SQL, Orac le and OLEDB data sources. 2. Data sources may be internal or external. 3. Internal database shall be automatically created as an MS Access datab ase in the project folder based on variable fields in the card design. 4. External database connectivity shall allow linking existing database field s to dynamic fields in the card design. 5. External CSV connection shall be supported.

6. Automatic creation of internal database shall reduce the requirement fo r manual database/table creation. 4. Photo and Signature Capture 1. Photo Capture: The software shall support direct photograph capture t hrough WIA-compatible devices. The software shall also support digital-cam era-based photo capture. The vendor shall demonstrate compatibility with t he proposed camera/device during installation and commissioning. 2. Scanner option shall support scanning photographs and saving them as images. 3. Signature Capture shall support dynamic signature capture during enrol ment. 4. The system shall support electronic signature capture through compatib le signature-pad devices, The captured signature shall be digitally acquired by the application and associated with the corresponding transaction/record 5. Integration with third-party devices shall be possible where required un der project mandate. 5. Card Encoding and Reading 1. Magnetic stripe card encoding shall support ISO-standard format and lin king of all three tracks to data fields. 2. Smart-card encoding shall support PC/SC, synchronous and contactless smart-card encoding. 3. Supported card types listed include Mifare Classic 1K, 2K and 4K, Mifare 3.2V, Mifare desfire 4. Smart Card Reading Application shall be embedded for verification of en coded card data. 5. Integrated Mifare encoding shall be supported for smart printers. 6. Mifare CSN shall be readable and updatable to the database in decimal or hexadecimal format and printable on the card. 7. iClass 16/16 application area encoding shall be supported. 8. PDF417 barcode shall be supported for data encoding. 6. Approval, Special Fields and Audit Trail 1. Approve Module shall allow supervisor approval of records submitted fo r printing. 2. Special Fields shall support tracking of printed/non-printed cards in an e xternal database, including print date, printed user and remarks. 3. Comprehensive audit trail reporting shall provide details of cards printe d. 4. Uniform property-tab positioning and Ribbon View shall facilitate naviga tion of frequently used design functions. 7. Integration 1. Auto Print shall provide integration capability with third-party applicatio ns. 2. The software shall provide an interface for configuring application settin gs including data-row height, client, encoder, reader, port number and defa ult printer. 3. Software shall provide capability to integrate third-party devices where required by the project. 8. Software Version / Feature Matrix

Design Tool Should be available Internal DB MS Access External DB ODBC / OLEDB Photo Capture Should be available Signature Capture Should be available Dual Side Print Should be available Batch Print Should be available Auto Print Should be available QR Encoding Should be available Magnetic Stripe Should be available Mifare Encoding Should be available Smart Card Encoding Should be available UV Encoding Should be available Special Fields Should be available Integration Should be available Audit Trail Report Should be available 9. Software Architecture and Licensing 1. The software shall be compatible with Windows 10.0 and above. 2. The application has capability to link to OLEDB-supported external data bases. 3. The application should have online registration facility using the CD key supplied by the vendor. 4. Warranty should be minimum 1 year 10. Additional points 1. Installation and training should be provided by the vendor 2. The supplier should provide on-site training to the end user after successful installation 3. Test certificate & Operating manual both in hard form and soft form shall be supplied along wi th the software 4. Software should be provided in CD 5. Software license should be perpetual and software shouldn’t be MAC address binding Kindly mention the GeM Bid no. & BHAVINI ref. no. 1000542 1 in all future correspondences. . 4.
